A group whose root is already deleted is reported, not failed, so the row keeps holding after the cutover merges. It proves the import graph only; the manifest's trial deletes (tsc + vitest) were run once, on c8bbf95de + #487.

The nightly manifest's `legacy` value for every non-chrome page matches App.tsx: `page` only where a `<PageGate page="<slug>" legacy=` slot exists, `none` only where none does. The ADR 0149 trial cutover (CUTOVER-MANIFEST-2026-09-28.md §6) deleted 25 legacy slots and 3 redirect slots; with their entries left at `page`, the nightly flag-off walk would have failed every one of them after deploy (nightly.spec.ts asserts no Mudavym root for `page`), and check_nightly_manifest.py does not read `legacy`. A group the founder refuses restores its slot, which turns this row STALE until its entry goes back to `page`. Mutation-tested 2026-09-28 both ways (a `none` entry with a slot, a `page` entry without one).
